title: Test Generation & Logging
summary: Turn a locked PRD, Change Request, Bug Fix Spec, Design Spec, Milestone Plan, or Work Scope Brief into a Test Plan: risk-ranked coverage, cases traced to acceptance criteria, and observed execution results. Requirements-based plans may come from a PRD; implementation-specific cases without environment detail are not run, never PASS. Continue here when a spec needs tests. Launch with empty inputs to discover eligible sources. Does not fix defects.
